answer: Capability-Use Merkle Registry: each identity gets a Merkle path whose leaves are its signed actions; peers only accept work carrying a valid path chained to a shared trellis root. Registering a new identity requires generating a fresh keypair and paying to have its first leaf anchored by two existing members, who forfeit reputation if it misbehaves. A haven of honest nodes rejects unanchored paths at validation. Cloning therefore costs a keypair plus two anchor signatures per clone and risks anchors' standing, making honesty cheaper.
